rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a cemetery or burial ground.

example.english: We used to go to the cemetery to pay our respects all the time.
example.traditional: 我哋以前成日去墳場拜山。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 heoi3 fan4 coeng4 baai3 saan1

rows.note: Use this as a more formal or neutral term, especially when referring to the burial land itself rather than simply saying 墳場.

example.english: This plot of land is a cemetery planned by the government.
example.traditional: 呢幅地係政府規劃嘅墓地。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 dei6 hai6 zing3 fu2 kwai1 waak6 ge3 mou6 dei6
